creative_brief.emotional_promise: Invite a quiet, record-player-side ritual in which one gentle turn makes visible geometry feel like a tiny weather sequence worth watching as closely as listening.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A compact A5 portrait booklet keeps the 120 mm circular product and small captive parts legible at useful scale while six tightly assigned pages provide a natural cover, inventory, two-stage setup, listening experiment, and care-reference arc without filler.
creative_brief.physical_format: Six-page A5 portrait mini-booklet, 148 × 210 mm, with 12 mm safe margins and no bleed-dependent meaning.
teaching_arc: Recognize the dial and its three-field promise
Identify all six exact printed parts and orientation cues
Lock the deck and capture the plectrum with the keeper
Seat the wheel, lock the cap, and perform pre-use checks
Make one guided clockwise listening revolution and continue through reset
Troubleshoot, care for, store, and stop safely
typography: Headings and action labels — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Bold
Body, captions, and limitations — embedded Bitstream Vera Sans Roman
creative_brief.visual_motif: Concentric turntable-like circles, generous quiet fields, and three distinct rib-line patterns echo the exact annular CAD; names, counts, spacing, and position repeat every color cue.

findings: The independent first-render review found a global text-flow blocker: body copy clipped at the right trim, page 5 columns overlapped, and page 6 safety copy escaped its panel.
The independent reviewer found that the first inventory did not visually isolate all six parts and that setup lacked enough exact orientation visuals for a first-time owner.
resolved_changes: Reset inherited character spacing, constrained and reflowed every text frame, separated the page 2 cards, resized the page 6 safety panel, and rerendered all six final pages in color and grayscale.

Replaced the repeated inventory screenshot with exact silhouettes derived from all six sealed part STLs, added explicit orientation cues plus an exact wheel-plectrum-keeper setup strip, and cropped CAD-review chrome from the cover visual.
